**NG Setup with a duplicate RAN node ID**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / Interface Management Procedures / NG Setup |
| Tags | negative |
| Verdict class | DEVIATION |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.7.1.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-19: in V19.4.0 the same words are a bullet under "If the NG Setup procedure is executed between the NG-RAN node and the AMF")
- TS 38.413 9.3.1.5 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 38.413 8.7.1.3 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-DUPLICATE-RAN-NODE-ID.md).
